C++.static_analysis_config: Enable all checkers in Clang Static Analyzer, focus on security-related checks. Configure memory leak detection and undefined behavior detection.
C++.cve_integration: Integrate OWASP Dependency-Check into CI/CD pipeline to scan third-party libraries. Configure Dependabot alerts for GitHub repositories.
C++.sast_integration: Configure CodeQL with C++ language pack focusing on memory safety, pointer arithmetic, and buffer overflow vulnerabilities.
C++.code_quality_metrics: Cyclomatic complexity < 15, comment ratio > 20%, function length < 50 lines

Python.static_analysis_config: Focus on input validation, SQL injection, and command injection vulnerabilities. Enable type checking with mypy.
Python.cve_integration: Run Safety check on requirements.txt in CI/CD pipeline. Configure PyUp for automatic dependency updates.
Python.sast_integration: Configure CodeQL with Python language pack focusing on SQL injection, XSS, and path traversal vulnerabilities.
Python.linter_config: Configure Bandit to scan for common security issues in Python code. Enable all security plugins in Pylint.
Python.code_quality_metrics: Cyclomatic complexity < 10, maintainability index > 65, function length < 40 lines

JavaScript.static_analysis_config: Focus on prototype pollution, XSS prevention, and secure coding patterns. Enable security-related ESLint plugins.
JavaScript.cve_integration: Run npm audit in CI/CD pipeline. Configure Snyk to scan package.json/package-lock.json files.
JavaScript.sast_integration: Configure CodeQL with JavaScript language pack focusing on XSS, prototype pollution, and insecure deserialization.
JavaScript.linter_config: Configure ESLint with eslint-plugin-security and eslint-plugin-node for security-focused linting.
JavaScript.code_quality_metrics: Cyclomatic complexity < 10, maintainability index > 70, function length < 30 lines

Java.static_analysis_config: Enable Find Security Bugs plugin for SpotBugs. Configure PMD with security-focused ruleset.
Java.cve_integration: Run OWASP Dependency-Check against Maven/Gradle dependencies in CI/CD pipeline.
Java.sast_integration: Configure CodeQL with Java language pack focusing on OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
Java.linter_config: Configure SpotBugs with Find Security Bugs plugin. Enable PMD's security ruleset.
Java.code_quality_metrics: Test coverage > 80%, cyclomatic complexity < 12, code duplication < 5%

Go.static_analysis_config: Run gosec with all rules enabled. Configure golangci-lint with security-focused linters.
Go.cve_integration: Run govulncheck in CI/CD pipeline to check for vulnerable dependencies.
Go.sast_integration: Configure CodeQL with Go language pack focusing on security issues like SQL injection and template injection.
Go.linter_config: Configure gosec with all security rules enabled. Use golangci-lint with security-focused linters.
Go.code_quality_metrics: Test coverage > 80%, cyclomatic complexity < 15, function length < 60 lines

Fortran.static_analysis_config: Enable memory safety checks and array bounds checking in compiler flags.
Fortran.cve_integration: Manual review of dependencies and regular checks against vulnerability databases.
Fortran.sast_integration: Configure Coverity Scan for automated analysis of Fortran code.
Fortran.linter_config: Enable all compiler warnings. Configure Fortran Lint for strict checking.
Fortran.code_quality_metrics: Procedures < 100 lines, minimal GOTO usage, proper variable initialization

general_recommendations.secret_detection_strategy: Run GitLeaks as a pre-commit hook and in CI/CD pipeline. Configure to detect API keys, passwords, tokens, and cryptographic keys.
general_recommendations.dast_strategy: Schedule weekly OWASP ZAP scans against development environments. Run baseline scans for each deployment.
general_recommendations.container_scanning_methods: Integrate Trivy into CI/CD pipeline to scan container images before deployment. Configure with fail-on-critical option.
general_recommendations.license_policy: Maintain a whitelist of approved licenses. Configure CI/CD pipeline to fail builds with unauthorized licenses.

cicd_templates.github_actions:
name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'

jobs:
  {{#LANGUAGES}}
  {{LANGUAGE_NAME}}-security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      {{LANGUAGE_SPECIFIC_STEPS}}
  {{/LANGUAGES}}

  secret-scanning:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: TruffleHog OSS
        uses: trufflesecurity/trufflehog@v3.16.0
        with:
          path: ./
          base: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          head: HEAD
          extra_args: --debug --only-verified

  container-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Build image
        run: docker build -t ${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }} .
      - name: Scan image
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: ${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }}
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-results.sarif'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'

  dependency-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Dependency Review
        uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v2
